openwrt_wiki.serial: Identical to Archer C7. Make sure you have shorted R24 on the PCB. Additionally, the A7 (and possibly others) require a pull up resistor on the RX line ... connecting this to VCC on the router (the normally unused pin next to GND) is sufficient. 115200, 8N1

Hardware identisch mit Archer C7 v5 (FCC), eigene Firmware. Innen, 12 V 1.5 A Hohlstecker (Netzteil T120150-2B1), 5x Gbit, 1x USB 2.0, 3 feste Dualband-Antennen, 3x3 je Band, 128 MB RAM / 16 MB NOR.
